summary: Bush-side kerb above the motorway; houses 20-30 m across the road.
reasons: Backs onto bush and motorway verge
Houses across road, 20 m or more

drivers.seclusion: Bush strip and motorway on this side; houses across the narrow street, nearest in the section about 20-30 m, 10 m at 28 m along.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; only a thin grass verge on this side before trees and the motorway fence, so room to pull fully off is doubtful.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street, but constant motorway noise from the south.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; one parked near the north houses.

flags: Steeper to the south: about 4.5% mean, 14% max over the full stretch
Low-lying: about 6 m elevation, waterway 39 m away
House 10 m from the kerb at 28 m along
Mapped gate 66 m away has a way round it
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the south and east sides shades the morning; open to the afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is wide enough to clear the lane

best_section.where: Market Street North, bush side of the bend nearest the footpath, before the nearest house
